name: Camballin
reason: Wikivoyage names it twice, but only for river fishing and as a highway stop with no accommodation; nothing else to see is named, so it is a town that reaches review at best (brief: a town with nothing a source names to see is reject or review).

name: El Questro Station
reason: El Questro Wilderness Park: Wikivoyage Kununurra and Gibb River Road, Visit Broome (gorges, springs, permits, accommodation); a large park visitors base in. Emma Gorge and Zebedee Springs are distinct sites within it. Name it El Questro Wilderness Park (the redirect target).
